body:
📦 **meadow-telegraph `bb1e6a0`** — feat(ui): replace linear telegraph with circular engine-order controls

Show the current order on a compact brass dial and open a larger accessible
order wheel. Ahead is on the right, astern on the left; a separate stop
button calls the existing zero-power order. Retain configurable T/G keys.
Preview pointer drags without writing simulation state, commit once on a
valid release, and cancel on dead zones, pointer cancellation or ship change.
Keep focused keyboard controls separate from combat while allowing keyup
to clear held helm/sail actions. Ignore duplicate synthetic touch clicks.

Reference: Silent Hunter4's official Steam manual, page8 (PDF7), navigation
training. Native canvas and HTML controls; no copied game images.
Browser evidence and interaction contracts: docs/evidence/round-telegraph.
Build:143 JS files,836729 identical AST nodes,263 sources and44 unchanged ships.

Compact buttons explicitly opt into pointer events because the existing
HUD passes clicks through. Portrait and short landscape panels both fit.

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — Hololive Myth pool 核心成員, 傲嬌+殘感紀律+唯一手勢三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗底層嚴謹到極致 a~ 🦈
(Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
